name: פְּלַלְיָה
gloss: Yahweh has judged; or Yahweh has intervened
summary: Pelaliah son of Amzi, a priest, ancestor of Adaiah who served in the house after the return (Neh 11:12). The name is the verb פִּלֵּל “arbitrate, intervene” (1Sa 2:25; Psa 106:30) with יָה: Yahweh has decided, or stepped in.

evidence.note: “Adaiah son of Jeroham son of פְּלַלְיָה son of Amzi … son of Malchijah.”
“God פִּלְלוֹ”: God arbitrates between man and man.
“Phinehas stood וַיְפַלֵּל, and the plague was stayed.”

note: Takes q.bq.ah (1 token). TIPNR calls him a Levite in its description and a priest in its summary; Neh 11:10–12 lists him among the priests. The reading is the form's; no verse explains it.
